brief: Agile, fast but strong/sturdy southern-island boarding fighter. Pink, sky blue, rusty orange/ochre/beige. Preferred dark cropped jacket from concept 01 reconsidered as base. Large back anchor, current saber, animation-rig proportions preserved as design constraint.

variants.label: A
variants.prompt:
Create a NEW high-quality playable hero design for THE WAR REMAINS based closely on the attached Pelag concept. This is an iteration on the user's preferred DARK SHORT-JACKET version, not a different character. Pelag is an agile, fast but POWERFUL AND STURDY maritime BOARDING FIGHTER from the southern islands. His fighting identity is an elegant existing saber plus an enormous heavy anchor on a chain. He should have the commanding charisma, distinctive silhouette and physical credibility of a protagonist people are excited to play.

Use attached reference to retain recognizable warm-skinned Pelag, existing body scale and human animation-rig proportions, dark brown hair/brown eyes, coral-pink headband, short garment envelope, knee-length trousers and low sandals. Keep shoulder/elbow/knee placements, limb lengths and head-to-body ratio compatible with the current animations. Compact strong athlete, defined sturdy forearms and calves, agile waist, no bodybuilder bulk. More determined charismatic young-adult face and grounded tactile shading, not a glossy cute child. New practical rugged haircut: cropped temples, short swept-back textured crown, clean nape, no fashion fringe or giant hair spikes, original pink headband integrated.

SIGNATURE PALETTE is PINK, SKY/SEA BLUE and RUST/ORANGE-OCHRE-BEIGE. All three must be intentional readable colour masses, not dozens of trinkets. The appealing deep-dark base in this reference MAY anchor the palette; user now prefers this dark concept to the rejected alternatives. Actual costume cut and material design must convey a premium painterly fantasy game: smoky blue shaded planes, warm bone highlights, broad brush-lit cloth and weathered rust leather, polished silver weapon edges, warm worn metal accents. Painterly but dimensional and clean. Not just a colour filter or a special background.

Large back-mounted anchor: preserve the reference's smooth thick curved flukes, central diamond shape, robust ring and heavy interlocked chain, diagonal across back from one shoulder to opposite hip. About 0.95m tall and 0.6m wide for a 1.78m hero, very visible in silhouette, more like a brutal boarding weapon than a belt accessory. Keep it clear of knees. One practical broad harness. No dangling ornaments.
SABER must be his CURRENT GAME SABER, replacing the generic sheathed cutlass in the concept: broad curved silver blade with a distinctive stepped spine, short OLD-GOLD CROSSGUARD (not a D-loop basket), central pink-red diamond gem, small turquoise collar, brown leather grip crossed by coral wrap, rounded gold pommel with turquoise inset and short pink ribbon. Show unsheathed in his right hand held low; anchor attached on back. Keep existing one-hand grip geometry.
Few large shapes and meaningful details. No tiny patchwork, stitched scraps, filigree, rivets, many belts, jewellery, pirate hat, cape, bulky armour, huge boots or long coat. Short flexible clothing clear of shoulders, elbows, hips and knees for existing combat clips.

Wide landscape concept presentation: large confident full-body front three-quarter pose at left, smaller matching full-body rear view centre-right clearly showing back anchor, striking close-up face upper right and small isometric GAME-CAMERA view lower right. Consistent costume and weapons in every view. Full feet and sword in frame. Neutral pale stone-grey background so the character's own style and colour are judged. No fire, smoke, theatrical scenery or frame decoration concealing design. Tiny option letter only.
VARIANT A — dark boarding jacket, sky-blue shoulder masses, strong pink waist diagonal. Keep the preferred short jacket silhouette but sharpen the cut: matte deep ink-blue/charcoal cropped body, broad SKY-BLUE turned lapels and upper sleeve panels framing an open warm rust-beige linen chest; sleeves rolled just above elbows, one broad clean fold. A broad dusty PINK sash and pink headband are bold signature accents. Warm rust-orange ochre plain leather harness and simple bracers. Bone-beige cropped trousers with small dark outer planes, no black head-to-toe. One large ivory diagonal seam accent, not repetitive decoration. Compact robust torso, confident dynamic but relaxed stance, head tilted slightly forward with a ready-for-trouble half-smile. Keep the cool dark sophistication that made the attached concept memorable, enriched with Pelag's three real signature colours. Label 'A'.

VARIANT B — southern-island boarding captain, warm rust-ochre and sky blue with pink. Reinterpret the SAME short-jacket hero in a lighter more sun-worn maritime design: cropped RUST/OCHRE-BEIGE jacket in sturdy matte cloth, wide SKY-BLUE inner lapel and one broad blue panel running shoulder to waist. Short sleeves are rolled high, exposing original strong upper arms without altering their dimensions. Cream crossover undershirt, a large PINK waist sash and pink forehead band; pink appears also as one large inner facing, not scattered little ornaments. Muted deep sea-blue knee-length trousers, warm brown low sandals. One dark umber broad anchor strap and plain rust-brown bracers. One oversized simple geometric motif on sash only. Cloth forms a clear compact shoulder silhouette and tapered waist. Self-assured battle-ready young adult, no decorative captain epaulettes or costume clutter. Warm southern light expressed on materials, NOT via scenery. Label 'B'.

review_notes: Concept palette and costume candidates only; no Unity or model changes.
Generator added unwanted notches to saber blade. Existing runtime saber is the required production asset and must not be replaced with this detail.
Rig compatibility is a design constraint, not yet tested on a new 3D model.
